items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron saying
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron

items.quote: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites
items.claim: Instructions to not sever the Kohathites from the Levites
items.object: the tribe of the families of the Kohathites

items.quote: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden
items.claim: Aaron and his sons shall assign the Kohathites to their service and labor
items.mechanism: to his service and to his burden

items.quote: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die
items.claim: The Kohathites must not look upon the holy things when covered, on pain of death
items.mechanism: when the holy things are covered
